# Nivaran Technologies

> Nivaran Technologies is a Mumbai-based product studio, founded in 2026, that builds AI-driven software for safety, finance, social impact and everyday life. "Nivaran" is Sanskrit for "to resolve, to prevent".

## About
- Founder and CEO: Sagar Biswas
- Co-Founder and CTO: Unmesh Nikumbh
- Managing Director and Business Associate: Sandeep Redkar
- Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Contact: hello@nivarantechnologies.com
- Website: https://nivarantechnologies.com

## Services
- AI platforms and automation
- Web and mobile application development
- Design and user experience
- Backend and cloud engineering
- Systems integration and ongoing support

## Featured work (live demos)
- Suraksha Setu: public safety and safe-route platform
- Sakhi Wealth AI: AI-powered financial discovery platform
- Swar Shakti: government-linked marketplace supporting women entrepreneurs
- Phuket9: business and investment platform
